function: SAC agent chooses rotation angle, STAR-RIS phase shifts, amplitudes or mode, and offloading ratios per slot to minimize UD energy; transmit power and compute allocation derived analytically (pp. 7-8).
system: Single-antenna BS with MEC server, K=6 single-antenna moving UDs, rotatable N-element STAR-RIS (ES, MS, TS protocols), 2-bit phases, 5 MHz OFDMA, carrier frequency not stated (pp. 4, 10).
method: Soft actor-critic deep reinforcement learning with prioritized experience replay; actor and two critic networks, online training of up to 5000 episodes of 100 steps, Adam (pp. 8-10).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rician UD-RIS and RIS-BS channels (K-factor 10, path-loss exponent 2), Rayleigh direct link, Gauss-Markov mobility; data generated online by the RL environment, no dataset (pp. 4-5, 10).
test_conditions: Training and evaluation in the same simulated environment (UDs in a 2-7 m ring, 5 slots); sweeps over N=10-100, K=6-14, seeds 2020-2024; retraining per setting not stated (pp. 9-11).
baselines: Learned: PPO and DDPG (reported in text; Fig. 5 shows only SAC curves). Others: fixed-orientation STAR-RIS, reflection-only and transmission-only RIS, local processing without offloading (pp. 9-11).
metrics: Total UD energy consumption in J; reward versus training steps for convergence speed; UD trajectories and STAR-RIS orientation per slot (pp. 10-11).
complexity: Big-O training complexity in episodes, episode length and layer widths, plus action-generation complexity O(L1+L1L2+L2A) (p. 9); no runtime or FLOPs reported.
q1_support: p. 5: "modeled as the Rician distribution [14]". Custom Rician and Rayleigh simulator with own path loss; no 3GPP TR 38.901, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 11: "ranging from 2020 to 2024, and calculate the average energy" consumption for each number of UDs (Fig. 8). p. 9: "dimension equals 3K", so the network input depends on K. No test of a trained policy in an unseen scenario or after adaptation is reported.
q3_support: p. 9: "Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG)" and PPO are the learned baselines; p. 9: "Local Process: UDs execute tasks locally without offloading" is the non-learned one. The PPO and DDPG results are given in text on p. 10.
q4_support: p. 9: "with a generation complexity of O (L1 + L1 L2 + L2 A)", after the training complexity in Sec. IV-C (Complexity Analysis).
q5_support: p. 9: "In this section, numerical simulations are conducted to" validate the scheme; the data come from the authors' own simulated environment. No code or data link, DOI or repository appears in the paper.
notes: Area 3 and included under the joint rule: the SAC action mixes physical-layer decisions (STAR-RIS phases, amplitudes, mode, orientation) with an above-physical-layer one (offloading ratio). q3 rests on the text of p. 10 (PPO and DDPG compared 'in Fig. 5'), but the Fig. 5 shown has only SAC curves; the non-learned baseline is weak (local processing, fixed-orientation STAR-RIS), so the reviewer may confirm. q2 is 0 because no test in unseen conditions is stated.
